headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 12, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers edged out the Cleveland Guardians 6-4 in a closely contested matchup, with Chase DeLauter leading the Guardians' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. The Miami Marlins took down the Pittsburgh Pirates with a shutout performance, winning 2-0, led by Esteury Ruiz's home run and RBI. The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-6 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their teams' lineups. Kyle Karros, the Colorado Rockies' third baseman, has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion. Other notable injuries include José Suarez (Athletics, right hip strain), Blake Treinen (Los Angeles Dodgers, right elbow inflammation), and Jameson Taillon (Toronto Blue Jays, right forearm tendinits).

The Baltimore Orioles acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox in a trade, part of the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade. The Miami Marlins traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers edged out the Cleveland Guardians 6-4 in a closely contested matchup. Chase DeLauter led the Guardians' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Pirates in 2-0 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins took down the Pittsburgh Pirates with a shutout performance, winning 2-0. Esteury Ruiz led the Marlins' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Nationals 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-6 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jacob Webb earned the save with 1.1 scoreless innings, striking out 2 batters.

top_news.title: **Mariners Fall to Yankees in 4-1 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 4-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Randy Arozarena leading the Mariners' offense with a home run and an RBI. Bryan Woo pitched 5 strong innings for the Mariners, striking out 5 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Place Karros on 7-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies third baseman Kyle Karros has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion.

top_news.title: **Rivas Traded to Orioles**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox in a trade. The deal is part of the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade, with a player to be named later still to be determined.
